content:
Hi @leven2

The app doesn't support HTML formatting within the message compose window, which is required for inline image / banner placement.

You can raise your suggestion on Mozilla connect where community members can vote for the idea.

A request to add support for HTML composition can be found below. You can show support by voting for it.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/add-html-support-text-styling-in-k-9-mail-thunderbird-android/idi-p/52739

A request also exists for HTML signatures, which may be of interested to you.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/allow-html-signatures-in-k-9-mail-thunderbird-for-android/idi-p/28983
